comparison.interpretation: Descriptive repeat on a new private-only call sequence, not a causal state estimate; machine/time variation is not separately controlled.

limitations: Static flags do not prove state persistence; unflagged code may still contain indirect state.
All seven previously known labels in the flagged population were FAIL; no previously known PASS was covered.
88 UNKNOWN-to-FAIL descriptions are not PASS/FAIL flips and were not written back into main labels.
CPU machine differs from historical scoring, so this is not a causal state-only experiment.
Child CPU here sums candidate suite children; setup child CPU was about 0.82 seconds in the live /proc check.
